recentItems.title: Air Pollution: Can Toxic Air Damage Your Lungs Like Cigarettes? | Dr Ankit Bhatia
recentItems.description:
Can breathing polluted air damage your lungs as much as smoking cigarettes? Dr Ankit Bhatia, Senior Consultant at Yashoda Institute of Respiratory Medicine, explains how air pollution and cigarette smoke affect lung health. From dangerous PM2.5 particles and long-term lung damage to reduced lung capacity in children, the risks are serious. Can non-smokers develop smoking-related lung diseases? Can damaged lungs recover? Dr Bhatia also explains how N95 masks, HEPA air purifiers and limiting outdoor exposure can help protect against toxic air. Discover why air pollution is a major respiratory health threat and why smoking is never justified.
